logp.method_description: The lipophilicity test has involved the distribution of the degree of a compound between the octanol and aqueous phases. Log P was calculated as the decimal logarithm of the ratio of the solute concentration in n-octanol and water after partition equilibrium. The amount of complex solution (10 mL) was mixed with 20 mL of octanol and 30 mL of distilled water in 250 ml flask. The solution mixture was stirred by a mechanical shaker for 30 mins. The solution was allowed to stand for 24 h with clear separation of the aqueous and organic phases in 250 mL separating funnel. Moreover, 3 mL of solution was collected from each phase to determine the unknown concentrations present in each phases using UV-visible spectroscopy.
